request.description: Service authenticates as itself (client_credentials). Facade validates namespace (Orders.* for order-service, Identity.* for identity-facade) -> 400 on cross-namespace. Each permission becomes a Keycloak client role + oidc-usermodel-client-role-mapper (claim permissions) + auto-mapped to /key-admins. Never deletes a client role when removed from manifest.

Idempotently maps any client role not yet on /key-admins. After this, POST /api/identity/auth/refresh returns a new AT that already carries the permission (no re-login, no Admin Console). Requires admin.
Expect 400 ProblemDetails - namespace enforcement (order-service may only register Orders.*).

request.description: After Create/Replace scoped access + re-login/refresh, decode the JWT (jwt.io or: echo $TOKEN | cut -d. -f2 | base64 -d | jq). Expect flat claims authz.scope.region / authz.scope.test-key (arrays) plus aggregated permissions. Already-issued tokens do NOT mutate.

ScopeDictionaryConverter normalizes scalar "items-1" to ["items-1"] - no DTO change needed. Unknown/inactive/disallowed -> 400 with assignments[0].scopes.<key>. Resource isolation: test-key only on ResourceA.
Both keys scalar-or-array normalized; union Group+User gated at write; effective scopes via GET /api/identity/access-context.

item.name: Scopes (registry, Keycloak group /iam-scope-registry)
item.description: Registry lives in Keycloak group /iam-scope-registry: scope.<key>={displayName,description,isActive}, resource.<name>=[scopes]. Multivalued authz.scope.<key> on user/group -> flat JWT claims authz.scope.<key> via authz-scopes clientScope (User Profile admin-only).
